messages.content: Hi, I'm Alex. I just moved to Porto for a new job and I'd like help getting organised.
Welcome to Porto, Alex! What kind of work will you be doing?
I'm a data engineer at Norvik Logistics. I start on the 2nd of February.
Congratulations. Will you be commuting to an office?
Yes, the office is in Matosinhos. I plan to cycle there most days, it's about 9 kilometres.
Cycling 9 km is very doable. Porto has some steep hills though, so an e-bike might help.
I also brought my dog Biscuit with me. He's a four-year-old beagle.
Beagles love long walks. Parque da Cidade is great for dogs.
Good tip. I'm a big coffee person - my usual order is a cortado with oat milk.
Porto has lots of specialty cafés, and many offer oat milk now.
My birthday is on March 3rd, and my parents are visiting from Toronto that week.
Lovely. March is a nice time to show them around the Ribeira.
I'm learning Portuguese on Tuesday evenings at a school called Falar Bem.
That will help a lot with daily life. Consistent practice is key.
Hello, I'm Sam. I relocated to Braga last month for work.
Welcome to Braga, Sam! What do you do?
I'm a data analyst at Nordvik Freight. I started on the 15th of January.
Nice. How do you get to work?
I take the bus, it's about 25 minutes. I'm too nervous to cycle in traffic.
The bus is a relaxing option. You can read on the way.
I have a dog too, a three-year-old border collie called Pepper.
Border collies need a lot of exercise and mental stimulation.
I drink a lot of coffee. I always order a flat white with regular milk.
Braga has some great cafés near the cathedral.
My birthday is on July 21st. My brother is flying in from Dublin for it.
Sounds fun. July is a lively month in Braga.
I want to start a vegetable garden this spring. I'm thinking of building three raised beds.
Three raised beds is a good start. What do you want to grow?
Mostly tomatoes and basil. The backyard gets about six hours of direct sun.
Six hours is enough for tomatoes. Cedar is a good material for raised beds because it resists rot.
Totally unrelated, but my car started squealing when I brake. The garage quoted 240 euros for new brake pads.
Squealing often means worn pads. That price is within the normal range for pads and labour.
The garage is Ferreira Auto on Rua Central. They can take the car on Monday.
Monday works. Ask them to check the rotors while it's there.
Oh, and I have a job interview coming up with Lumen Health for a product manager role.
Exciting! When is the interview?
It's on October 12th at 10am, a panel interview with three people.
Prepare a few stories about prioritisation and working with engineers.
I also need to renew my passport before a trip to Japan in November.
Renewals can take several weeks, so apply soon.
Back to the garden: I decided on Sungold cherry tomatoes and Genovese basil.
Great choices. Sungold is very sweet and productive.
I'll plant them on April 20th, after the last frost.
Mid-to-late April is sensible for your area.
About the car - Ferreira Auto said the rotors were worn too, so the final bill was 310 euros.
That's a reasonable total for pads and rotors together.
And the interview: Lumen Health moved it to October 14th because one panelist was sick.
Thanks for the update. That gives you extra time to prepare.
Kicking off planning for Project Atlas, our new mobile banking app. Launch is set for June 3rd.
Noted: Project Atlas, launch on June 3rd. Who is leading the team?
Marco Silva is the team lead. The budget is 40,000 euros.
Got it. Marco Silva leads, with a 40,000 euro budget.
We'll have a weekly sync every Tuesday at 9:30.
Weekly Tuesday syncs at 9:30 are on the calendar.
The app will support iOS only for the first release.
An iOS-only first release reduces scope.
Update: the security review found issues, so the launch moves to June 17th.
Understood, the launch is moved to June 17th.
Also, finance approved extra funds. The budget is now 55,000 euros.
Budget updated to 55,000 euros.
Marco is going on parental leave, so Hana Kobayashi takes over as team lead starting May 1st.
Hana Kobayashi will lead the team from May 1st.
Hana prefers Thursdays, so the weekly sync moves to Thursday at 10:00.
Weekly sync moved to Thursdays at 10:00.
We decided the first release will support both iOS and Android after all.
The first release now covers both mobile platforms.
Final update on timing: the app store review delayed us, so launch is now July 1st.
Launch date is now July 1st.
I'm visiting Spain next month. My flight to Madrid is on the 9th.
Great, flying to Madrid on the 9th. Do you know anyone there?
My sister Leah lives in Madrid, so I'll stay with her for a few days.
Staying with Leah in Madrid will save on hotels.
I'd like to visit the Museo del Faro while I'm there.
The Museo del Faro is closed on Mondays, so plan around that.
I want to book a hotel for the last two nights. The hotel Wi-Fi password they emailed is harbour-27.
Noted the Wi-Fi password harbour-27.
I'm also allergic to penicillin, in case that matters for travel insurance.
Worth declaring that on your insurance form.
Correction: I misread my ticket. The flight is actually on the 11th, not the 9th.
Thanks for the correction, flight on the 11th.
Also I mixed up my family: Leah lives in Valencia. It's my cousin Tom who lives in Madrid, so I'll stay with Tom.
Understood: Leah is in Valencia, and you'll stay with your cousin Tom in Madrid.
I checked the museum website. The Museo del Faro is actually closed on Wednesdays, not Mondays.
Thanks for checking. I'll plan the museum visit for another day then.
One more fix: the Wi-Fi password was wrong. It's harbor-72, not harbour-27.
Updated the Wi-Fi password.
And I spoke with my doctor: my allergy is actually to sulfa drugs, not penicillin. I confused it with my brother's allergy.
Got it, I'll note the corrected allergy.
Let me introduce my team so you can help me plan an offsite. There are four people.
Great, tell me about each of them.
Ines is our designer. She's from Lisbon and she's allergic to nuts.
Noted: Ines, designer, Lisbon, nut allergy.
Omar is the backend developer. He's from Cairo and he's vegetarian.
Omar: backend developer from Cairo, vegetarian.
Mei is the product manager, originally from Taipei. She plays the violin in a community orchestra.
Mei: product manager from Taipei, violinist.
Jonas does QA. He's from Hamburg and has two cats named Pixel and Byte.
Jonas: QA from Hamburg, two cats.
For the offsite, Ines prefers somewhere near the sea, and Omar gets seasick so no boat trips.
A seaside venue but no boat activities. Anything else?
Mei will handle the budget, and Jonas volunteered to book the train tickets.
Understood, the budget and the train booking are covered.
Omar's birthday falls during the offsite, on September 8th, so let's plan a small cake with no nuts.
A nut-free birthday cake it is.
